mapper.select: SELECT DEPLOY_ID AS deployId, REL_ID AS relId, DEPLOY_REF AS deployRef, COMMIT_HASH AS commitHash, RESULT AS result, DEPLOY_TYPE AS deployType, LOG AS log, EXEC_BY AS execBy, TO_CHAR(EXEC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS execDt FROM OPS_DEPLOY_HIS WHERE REL_ID = #{relId} ORDER BY DEPLOY_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_DEPLOY_HIS (REL_ID, DEPLOY_REF, COMMIT_HASH, RESULT, DEPLOY_TYPE, LOG, EXEC_BY, EXEC_DT) VALUES (#{relId}, #{deployRef}, #{commitHash}, #{result}, #{deployType}, #{log}, #{execBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
